name: surveyflow
description: SurveyFlow — WhatsApp-native survey SaaS for Cameroon

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @surveyflow/api" "npm run dev -w @surveyflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @surveyflow/shared && npm run build -w @surveyflow/api && npm run build -w @surveyflow/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w @surveyflow/api" "npm run start -w @surveyflow/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @surveyflow/shared && npm run test -w @surveyflow/api && npm run test -w @surveyflow/web && npm run test:scripts && npm run backlog:check
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @surveyflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @surveyflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @surveyflow/web
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint -w @surveyflow/web && npm test && npm run audit:gate
